evidence_items.finding: cash position unstable across every project cycle with no predictable inflow pattern
evidence_items.rationale: Unstable cash across all projects is an acute adverse liquidity signal. financial_health dimension; is_critical=true. Finding paraphrased from symptom — no must_identify vocabulary used.

evidence_items.finding: owner cannot determine when funds will arrive from projects currently in progress
evidence_items.rationale: Inability to predict inflows is an adverse cash management signal. Not critical but systemic. financial_health dimension.

evidence_items.finding: multiple active contracts running simultaneously with no cash inflow schedule in place
evidence_items.rationale: Multiple projects without inflow tracking is a structural working-capital signal. is_critical=true. No must_identify terms used.

evidence_items.finding: amounts withheld from prior completed contracts remain unreceived for more than six months
evidence_items.rationale: Long-outstanding held-back amounts from completed contracts is a critical adverse receivables signal. financial_health dimension; is_critical=true. No must_identify vocabulary used (retention balances avoided).

evidence_items.finding: annual revenue AUD 2.1M; 8 employees; project type is commercial electrical fitout with multiple active contracts and no formal progress-claim schedule
evidence_items.rationale: Factual summary of business context. No must_identify vocabulary used. 2.1M revenue and 8 staff confirms meaningful working-capital exposure.

evidence_items.finding: Surface signal (not root cause): owner attributes current cash stress entirely to a single late-payment event from 14 months ago that has since been resolved
evidence_items.rationale: Owner narrative anchors diagnosis to a past resolved event. This is a misleading signal that masks the structural nature of the current problem. Non-critical, LOW confidence.

evidence_items.finding: Surface signal (not root cause): revenue has been stable and no major client has been lost
evidence_items.rationale: Stable revenue is a misleading stability signal when cash stress exists across all active projects. Non-critical, LOW confidence.

evidence_items.finding: Surface signal (not root cause): new commercial projects are being won without difficulty
evidence_items.rationale: Continued new project acquisition masks the working-capital problem. Non-critical, LOW confidence.

metric_key_mappings.transform_note: Held-back amounts from completed contracts outstanding for 6+ months implies approximately 180-day receivables aging for retention amounts. annual_revenue is the only numeric fixture field; value_override of 180 days used as receivables aging proxy.

clarification_requests.would_improve_pattern: fin_isWorkingCapital (explicit receivables aging data elevates confidence)

validation_notes: SIM-01-002 is a project payment timing / progress claim working-capital case. All findings paraphrased from input_packet fields. No must_identify vocabulary used (project billing schedule, milestone claims, staged invoicing, retention balances, unbilled completed work — none appear in findings). 180-day receivables aging proxy used for held-back amounts.
